title: Pay all separator area,duty and reset in an ohmic dissipation bound
statement: For the source block accounting convention,the necessary dissipative work obeys W_Omega >= (F j_C/u)(sum_i z_i sqrt(s_i r_i/f_i))^2,with delivered-carbon current defined over all installed separator area and the complete operation.

evidence.quote: ### 1. Area, duty and reset enter one dissipation bound
evidence.range_scope: Source-stated necessary ohmic bound with all installed sheets,actual duty,usable fraction and absolute charge/reset.

requires: Define j_C=F N_delivered/(T_cycle A_all),one Faraday per DELIVERED mole and ALL installed separator area. For each block i,z_i is absolute charge throughput per delivered carbon,s_i counted sheets,r_i full-cell area resistance,f_i operating duty;u is usable installed-area fraction.

The source ohmic block model and its area/duty allocation conventions. Every reset/parasitic charge belongs in absolute z_i;the same physical reused separator is counted once with its complete charge/time history. Positive finite resistance/duty for participating blocks.
provides: Necessary bound W_Omega >= (F j_C/u)(sum_i z_i sqrt(s_i r_i/f_i))^2. Electrical work recovery cannot cancel irreversible I^2 R dissipation.
Stored charge window is distinct from absolute passed charge:an elementary charge/discharge passes twice the stored window. The predecessor0.680M liquid carbon capacity measures neither.
assumptions: This is a source-stated necessary ohmic bound,not a complete thermodynamic/process lower bound,performance prediction,measured coefficient or proof that an optimized allocation can be physically routed.
Maintain consistent resistance,area,current-density and molar-energy units;do not count only active main membrane or ignore auxiliary separator sheets.
costs: Actual full-operation duty,all installed sheets,usable fraction,absolute reset/parasitic charge and complete block resistance;nonohmic/capture/gas/water/mechanical losses remain additional.
contract.units: j_C in A per physical area;F coulomb/mol;r_i resistance times area;z_i electron equivalents/delivered carbon;W_Omega J/mol with consistent SI units.
